_comment: Named fee-tier profiles for the fake Kraken client. Spec 100 step 1.
These are INVENTED TEST DATA for a fake exchange. They are not Kraken's fee
schedule and no code outside tests/ may read them. Invariant 2 is absolute:
the real fees come from POST /0/private/TradeVolume at runtime or the trade
Tier 1 is the same fact as trade_volume.json's result and is pinned equal to
it by test_the_tier_1_profile_is_the_default_envelope, so the two cannot drift.
Tier 3 is the profile every Phase 6 criterion that drives a trade runs at.
NEITHER TIER HERE IS INVARIANT 5'S REFERENCE SCHEDULE, AND NEITHER IS A
NO-TRADE REGIME. Measured 2026-09-18 on the committed subject (BTC/USD, expected
move 3.0%): at tier 3 engine 10 computed friction 0.308% and hurdle 0.462%; at
tier 1 it computed friction 0.708% and hurdle 1.062%, cleared, and engine 18
placed the entry. The no-trade finding belongs to Kraken's reference schedule
(invariant 5: tier-1 friction about 1.25%, bar 3.125% against the 3.0% target),
not to this file. This comment said otherwise until operator ruling S3, and every
trade criterion's message now states the friction its own run computed.
Do not change hurdle_multiple to produce a trade.
